standard_prerequisites.name: Renewal theory, homogeneous pinning free energy, Tauberian estimates, basic Fourier analysis and probability inequalities as cited by the authors
standard_prerequisites.use: Standard cited foundations only; all selected local constructions and proof estimates remain in source ranges.

core_obligations: Control the intersection renewal mass uniformly over a compact range of defective renewal laws.
Compare annealed partition functions above and below criticality with homogeneous renewal models and obtain matching exponents.

proof_roadmap.step: Control the intersection renewal mass uniformly over a compact range of defective renewal laws.

difficulty_reason: Uniform renewal-mass bounds and two-sided partition-function comparisons are retained author work. This gives H2 material beyond the value of the critical curve.

compared.difference: Old 2687 is a quenched smoothing upper bound. This is the two-sided annealed exponent; the new critical-curve asymptotics concern a different function and limit.
